title: Light non-vacuum BMS$_3$ blocks at order $1/c_{M}$
summary: We derive a closed expression for the $1/c_{M}$ correction to highest-weight BMS$_3$ blocks with four light external primaries of generic weights and non-vacuum exchange. With $c_L$ and all operator weights held fixed, we prove that the global sector and descendants containing exactly one non-global generator $L_{-n}$ or $M_{-n}$ with $n\geq2$ suffice through this order. This truncation reduces the intrinsic calculation to global blocks and their derivatives, whose contributions we resum for nonzero exchanged boost weight $ξ_{p}$.
